# Asset sources and licenses

## Summary

**No external art, sprites, sound effects, music, icons or font files are included in the website.** Every visual and audio asset is original and generated by code in this repository.

## Original, procedurally generated assets

| Asset | How it is made | Location |
| --- | --- | --- |
| In-game graphics (runner, spikes, blocks, drones, shards, skyline, sun, bricks, paddle, ball, ships, enemies, starfields, particles) | Drawn at runtime with the Canvas 2D API | `src/games/*/renderer.ts`, `src/games/engine/canvas.ts` |
| Game card and hero artwork | Hand-written inline SVG | `src/components/games/GameArt.tsx` |
| Logo and favicon | Hand-written SVG | `src/components/layout/Logo.tsx`, `src/app/icon.svg` |
| UI icons (play, pause, sound, feature icons) | Hand-written inline SVG | `src/components/games/GameShell.tsx`, `src/app/page.tsx` |
| Sound effects | Synthesized at runtime with the Web Audio API (oscillators and generated noise) | `src/games/engine/audio.ts` |
| Social preview images (`/og/*.png`) and iOS icon (`/apple-touch-icon.png`) | Rendered at build time from code with `next/og` | `src/lib/seo/og-image.tsx`, `src/app/og/`, `src/app/apple-touch-icon.png/` |
| Game and guide text | Written for this project | `src/content/` |

The game designs are original implementations of common genres (endless runner, brick breaker, vertical shooter). No code, art, names, levels or audio were copied from existing commercial games.

## Fonts

- **Website text** uses the visitor's system fonts (`system-ui`, Segoe UI, Roboto, etc.). No font files are shipped.
- **Social preview images** are rendered at build time with the **Geist Regular** font bundled inside Next.js (`next/dist/compiled/@vercel/og/Geist-Regular.ttf`). Geist is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, which permits using the font to render text in images. The font file itself is not redistributed by this site.

## Software dependencies

Shipped to browsers (runtime): `next`, `react` and `react-dom`, all under the **MIT License**. Their license texts are in `node_modules/<package>/LICENSE`.

Development-only tools (`typescript`, `eslint`, `eslint-config-next`, `vitest`, `vite`, `playwright-core`, `@types/*`) are not part of the deployed site. They use permissive open-source licenses (MIT or Apache-2.0); check each package's `LICENSE` file for details.

## Adding assets in the future

Before adding any external asset:

1. Use only assets you created, commissioned with a written license, or that are explicitly licensed for commercial use (for example CC0, or CC BY with attribution).
2. Record each one in a table here: file path, source URL, author, license, attribution text and the date obtained.
3. Add any required attribution to the site (for example on `/about`).
4. Never use sprites, music, sound effects, logos or characters from existing games or brands.

| File | Source | Author | License | Attribution required | Date added |
